answer: Every agent renews identity at a juniper checkpoint, a $25 video liveness test one human passes only once per hour. A pass issues a signed beacon agents check before trading, each beacon carries a face hash so one person holds one. Each epoch five rotating auditors run a gale audit, re-testing a random 10%, and one failed re-test voids every beacon tied to that face and burns the fees. Forging 100 clones needs 100 distinct people plus 100 phones at $90 each, $11,500 total against $25 for one honest agent. Copying an identity is like photocopying a passport that melts in the rain.
